objective.classification: mean ground-truth cross entropy over the actual 100-image construction batch
objective.bn: sum over BatchNorm2d input statistics of w_l*(L2(batch_mean-running_mean)+L2(batch_variance-running_variance))

pixel_optimization.batches: one rank slot at a time; one image per class; three independent Adam states
pixel_optimization.augmentation: independent per-image HorizontalFlip(p=0.5), paired across arms
pixel_optimization.export: lossless RGB PNG quantized by round(255*x)

arms.cam_protected: top 15053 initial CAM pixels restored exactly after every update
arms.random_protected: same CAM mask circularly shifted by a stable per-image 2D offset

cam.definition: ReLU(sum_k fc_weight[y,k]*layer4_feature[k]) on the initial unflipped R0 image, bilinear upsampled from 7x7 to 224x224

downstream.fkd: standard-v2 fullframe+flip+CutMix metadata replay; ResNet Teacher42 train-mode BSSL relabeling of exported pixels
downstream.student: standard protocol v2 ImageNet-V1 ResNet18, T20 KL without T^2, three student seeds 42/43/44
